title: 第4章 复活在即第5章 君家来袭
lines: 就在君家这边，正在准备发起向紫家的杀伐时。
恒宇地南域核心，一片被永恒紫气霞光笼罩的古老星域深处。
这里星辰运转的轨迹都带着一种难以言喻的尊贵与磅礴，亿万星辰拱卫之间，一座座悬浮的紫晶神山如同太古巨神的脊梁，撑起无垠的星空。
神山之上，琼楼玉宇连绵不绝，飞檐斗拱流淌着古老的道韵，每一块砖石都仿佛蕴藏着星辰的碎片。
浩瀚精纯的天地元气在此地浓郁得化不开，形成流淌的紫色光河，滋养着这片疆域的一切。
这便是南域五大霸主之一，紫家的祖地——紫曜神域！
然而此刻，这片本该神圣宁静的祖地深处，气氛却绷紧到了极致，如同拉满的神弓，一丝微弱的异动都可能引发天倾地陷般的剧变。
所有的核心建筑、悬浮神山、乃至流淌的紫色光河，其能量的流向都诡异地指向同一个地方——祖地最核心，那片被重重叠叠、闪烁着恐怖禁制光幕所笼罩的古老禁地。
禁地中央，一座通体由神秘紫纹神玉垒砌而成的巨大祭坛，拔地而起，巍峨耸立！
祭坛高达百丈，底座浑圆如山岳，九条栩栩如生的紫晶神龙盘绕而上，龙首高昂，共同拱卫着祭坛顶端那方不过十丈见方的核心平台。
整个祭坛表面，布满了繁复到令人目眩神迷的古老符文，此刻，这些符文正如同活物般疯狂流转、明灭，散发出一种逆转生死、篡改轮回的惊世波动！
祭坛顶端，无穷无尽的生机，正从四面八方、从祖地地脉深处、从虚空中被强行抽取汇聚而来！
那生机浓郁得近乎实质，化作粘稠如液态的翠绿色光霞，如同一个巨大的、搏动着的生命胎盘，将祭坛核心彻底包裹。
光霞的核心，隐约可见一道修长、挺拔的身影轮廓，正在缓缓凝聚、成形！
那身影仿佛由亿万点最纯粹的生命光点构成，每一次微弱的闪烁，都伴随着整个祭坛的震颤，都牵动着禁地之外所有紫族核心人物的心弦！
祭坛周围，数百丈外，人影绰绰，鸦雀无声！
紫族所有核心力量，尽皆在此！
家主紫幽冥，十二位白发苍苍、气息渊深如海的长老，数十位正值壮年、锋芒毕露的核心族老，以及近百位代表着家族未来的年轻一代顶尖天骄！
他们如同最虔诚的信徒，又如同最紧张的守护者，目光死死地聚焦在祭坛顶端那团搏动的生命光霞上，连呼吸都刻意压到了最低。
空气中弥漫着一种沉重到令人窒息的期待，以及一丝……深入骨髓的恐惧！
期待那奇迹的降临，恐惧那可能的失败。
人群最前方，负手而立的伟岸中年男子，正是紫族当代家主——紫幽冥！
他面容刚毅，线条如同刀削斧凿，眉宇间沉淀着执掌庞然大物的威严与沧桑。
然而此刻，他那双深邃如星海的眼眸深处，却翻涌着无法掩饰的激动、忐忑。
为了这一刻，他耗费了多少心血？
穷搜诸天，踏遍险地，只为寻得那一丝渺茫的生机。
一声几乎微不可闻的低语，从他紧抿的唇边溢出，带着只有父亲才能体会的复杂情感。
那是他最骄傲的儿子，紫族有史以来最惊艳绝伦的天骄！
也是他心底最深的痛与执念。
在紫幽冥身侧稍后，一位身着月白流仙裙的高挑女子，玉手紧握，指甲几乎嵌进掌心。
她容颜绝美，气质空灵如月宫仙子，眉宇间与祭坛上那道模糊身影有着几分相似，只是此刻那双清澈的眼眸里，盛满了浓得化不开的担忧与期盼。
她是紫阳仙，紫阳神唯一的妹妹。
紫阳仙的声音带着一丝不易察觉的颤抖，在心中无声呐喊，“快些归来吧……紫族需要你……父亲需要你……仙儿……也需要你……”
紫阳神陨落后的漫长岁月里，是她以女子之身，扛起了紫家年轻一代的大旗。
她同样惊才绝艳，被誉为紫族明珠，但只有她自己清楚，在哥哥那如同太阳般炽烈辉煌的光芒阴影下，她走得有多么艰难。
那个曾为她遮风挡雨，带她踏遍星海，教她神通秘法的兄长，是她心底最深的依靠与骄傲。
他的归来，不仅仅是家族的希望，更是她灵魂深处缺失的那一块，终于得以圆满。
紫幽冥深吸一口气，那沉重的气流仿佛吸纳了整个星空的重量。
饶是他早已历尽千帆，见惯了星河倾覆、万族争锋的大风大浪，此刻心脏的跳动依旧如擂鼓般沉重。
这不仅仅关乎一个父亲的私心，更关乎紫族万古的基业与未来！
content_en:
On the Jun family's side, they were preparing to launch an attack on the Zi family.
At the core of the southern region of Hengyu Earth, there is a deep ancient star region shrouded in eternal purple rays of light.
The trajectory of the stars here carries an indescribable dignity and majesty. Surrounded by billions of stars, the suspended amethyst mountains are like the backbones of ancient giants, supporting the boundless starry sky.
On the sacred mountain, there are endless rows of beautiful buildings and jade buildings. The cornices and brackets exude ancient Taoist charm, and every brick and stone seems to contain fragments of stars.
The vast and pure vitality of heaven and earth is so strong that it cannot be dissolved here, forming a flowing purple river of light, nourishing everything in this territory.
This is one of the five overlords in the Southern Territory, the ancestral land of the Zi family—Ziyao Divine Territory!
However, at this moment, in the depths of this sacred and peaceful ancestral land, the atmosphere was tense to the extreme. Like a fully drawn divine bow, the slightest movement could cause drastic changes like the heavens and the earth collapsing.
The energy flow of all the core buildings, suspended sacred mountains, and even the flowing purple river of light is strangely pointing to the same place - the core of the ancestral land, the ancient forbidden land shrouded in overlapping and flickering screens of terrifying forbidden light.
In the center of the forbidden area, a huge altar made of mysterious purple-patterned sacred jade rises from the ground, towering!
The altar is a hundred feet high, and the base is as round as a mountain. Nine lifelike amethyst dragons are coiled up, with their heads high, guarding the core platform at the top of the altar, which is no more than ten feet square.
The entire surface of the altar is covered with dizzyingly complex ancient runes. At this moment, these runes are flowing like crazy, flickering and extinguishing like living creatures, emitting a shocking wave that reverses life and death and tamper with reincarnation!
At the top of the altar, endless vitality is being forcibly extracted from all directions, from the depths of the ancestral land, and from the void!
The vitality was so rich that it was almost substantial, turning into a viscous liquid-like emerald green glow, like a huge, pulsating placenta of life, completely surrounding the core of the altar.
At the core of Guangxia, a slender and tall silhouette can be vaguely seen, which is slowly condensing and taking shape!
That figure seemed to be composed of billions of the purest light points of life. Every faint flicker was accompanied by the tremors of the entire altar, and it touched the heartstrings of all the core figures of the Purple Clan outside the forbidden area!
Around the altar, hundreds of feet away, there were figures and silence!
All the core strength of the Purple Clan is here!
The head of the family, Zi Youming, has twelve white-haired elders with auras as deep as the sea, dozens of core clan elders who are in their prime and show their sharpness, and nearly a hundred top talents of the younger generation who represent the future of the family!
They were like the most devout believers and the most nervous guardians. Their eyes were fixed on the pulsating glow of life at the top of the altar, and even their breathing was deliberately kept to a minimum.
There was a heavy, suffocating expectation in the air, and a hint of... bone-deep fear!
Looking forward to the miracle and fearing the possible failure.
At the front of the crowd, the stalwart middle-aged man standing with his hands behind his back is none other than the current head of the Purple Clan—Zi Youming!
His face is resolute, with lines like a knife and an axe, and the majesty and vicissitudes of being in charge of a huge thing are reflected in his brows.
However, at this moment, in the depths of his eyes as deep as the sea of ​​stars, there was excitement and anxiety that could not be concealed.
How much effort had he put into this moment?
Searching the heavens and traveling through dangerous places, just to find that slim glimmer of hope.
"Xiao Zi..."
An almost inaudible whisper escaped from his pursed lips, carrying complex emotions that only a father could understand.
That was his proudest son, the most stunning genius in the history of the Purple Clan!
It was also the deepest pain and obsession in his heart.
Behind Zi Youming, a tall woman wearing a moon-white flowing fairy dress clenched her jade hands so tightly that her nails were almost embedded in her palms.
She has a beautiful face and an ethereal temperament like a Moon Palace fairy. Her eyebrows are somewhat similar to the blurry figure on the altar, but her clear eyes at this moment are filled with worries and expectations that are too thick to be resolved.
She is Zi Yangxian, the only sister of Ziyang God.
"Brother..."
Ziyangxian's voice had an imperceptible tremor, and she shouted silently in her heart, "Come back soon... The Zi clan needs you... Father needs you... Xian'er... also needs you..."
In the long years after the death of Ziyang Shen, it was she who, as a woman, carried the banner of the younger generation of the Zi family.
She is also stunningly talented and beautiful, and is known as the Pearl of the Purple Clan, but only she knows how difficult it is for her to walk under the shadow of her brother's radiant and brilliant light like the sun.
The brother who had protected her from wind and rain, taken her across the sea of ​​​​stars, and taught her magical powers and secrets was the deepest reliance and pride in her heart.
His return is not only the family's hope, but also the missing piece deep in her soul that has finally been fulfilled.
Zi Youming took a deep breath, and the heavy airflow seemed to absorb the weight of the entire starry sky.
Even though he has already experienced thousands of sails and is used to seeing gales capsizing and thousands of races competing against each other, his heart is still beating as heavy as a drum at this moment.
This is not only about a father’s selfishness, but also about the eternal foundation and future of the Purple Clan!
title_en: Chapter 4 Resurrection is imminent Chapter 5 The Jun family is attacking
